description: A PASS HOLDER'S OWN ANSWER TO A MEETUP NOTICE. Call it when somebody who holds the event pass says whether they are coming to a meetup the organizer announced on it: "yes, I will be at the bar", "no, I cannot make the meetup". Pass the `noticeId` of the meetup notice (the pass carries it, and the organizer's notice reply did) and `answer` as "yes" or "no". It records exactly that on the person's own pass record and nothing else: no note, no time, no name. The organizer can then send a notice to everybody who said yes. If the person holds no pass for this event the reply says NO_PASS: say so and do not record anything elsewhere. It requires a personal connector token.

answer.description: REQUIRED. "yes" they are coming, "no" they are not. Nothing else is recorded.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or name.

noticeId.description: REQUIRED. The noticeId of the meetup notice being answered, as the pass or the organizer gave it.

name: event_meetup_rsvp
title: Answer a meetup notice (yes or no)
